description: Blood centres in Punjab whose identity comes from a published public listing. Stock for these facilities remains synthetic.

fieldRules.dataSource: Must be PUBLIC_REGISTRY for every record in this file. A synthetic facility belongs in scripts/seed_demo.py instead.
fieldRules.inventoryDataSource: Must be SYNTHETIC. A public listing establishes that a place exists; it says nothing about what is on its shelves. REPORTED_BY_FACILITY is reserved for stock a facility submitted through LifeLink itself.
fieldRules.coordinateProvenance: One of SURVEYED, GEOCODED_ADDRESS or CITY_CENTROID. CITY_CENTROID means the town centre was used because no address-level position was available; the interface then says distances are indicative only. Never record SURVEYED for a coordinate that was not taken from the facility's own published position.
fieldRules.sourceUrl: Must be the http(s) page or document the fields were actually read from -- not a search engine, and not a page that merely mentions the source.
fieldRules.sourceRetrievedOn: ISO date the source was read, so a reader can judge how stale the record is.
fieldRules.verificationStatus: Omit, or set UNVERIFIED. Appearing in a public listing is not LifeLink verifying that the centre is operating today, and the existing verification badge means the latter.
